title: PAR-134 CMC method bytes C0-C8 source audit
mode: official API and local-code research; no semantic promotion

oda.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, local copy /Users/dli/doc/dwg/OpenDesign_Specification_for_.dwg_files (1).pdf
oda.finding: ODA defines the generic R2004+ CMC record structure but does not enumerate all AcCmEntityColor method values or establish every method's packed payload semantics.

autodeskColorMethod.finding: The ColorMethod enum starts at kByLayer=0xC0 and continues contiguously through kNone=0xC8: ByLayer, ByBlock, ByColor, ByACI, ByPen, Foreground, LayerOff, LayerFrozen, None. The docs say ByPen, LayerOff, LayerFrozen, and None are internal-only for third-party applications.

autodeskColorValue.finding: AcCmColor::color describes the high byte as color method and the lower bytes as color components; this is API-level method evidence, not a producer sample for every CMC payload.

autodeskForegroundIndex.finding: Autodesk identifies kACIforeground as ACI 7. This makes C5-to-ACI-7 a candidate semantic mapping but does not establish the CMC low-24-bit payload or HATCH gradient writer form.

libredwgSourceCrossCheck.finding: The mutable dwg_color_method_name helper names C5 Foreground and C8 None, while its C2/C3 labels differ from the local ODA/Autodesk-backed RGB/ACI interpretation. This is a source-level divergence signal only, not a normative byte-layout authority or runtime result.

localCode.finding: The general getCmColor decoder semantically handles only C0-C3 and returns 256 for other method bytes. VISUALSTYLE stores raw method/value metadata and its generated C8 control can be replayed byte-exactly, while the normalized field currently receives 256.

changes.internalEnumOnly: dwgColor now declares ACI=0xC3 with ACIS retained as a historical alias, names C4-C7, and renames C8 WINDOW_BG to NONE.

disposition: Keep C0-C3 as the only semantically projected methods in the current HATCH gradient path.
Treat C5 Foreground to ACI 7 as a candidate only until an ODA example or eligible real DWG establishes packed payload and optional-name behavior.
Keep C4 and C6-C8 opaque/unsupported for third-party semantic projection and do not normalize them to ByLayer.
Inventory all shared getCmColor consumers before changing its fallback because it feeds many entity and object readers.
limits: No independent DWG producer sample was available or run for C4-C8.
No LibreDWG runtime was executed; the mutable source helper is not a conformance oracle.
Autodesk API method semantics do not by themselves establish all serialized CMC payload details.
Findings/top-level subplans remain 144/78; J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
next: Continue the CMC consumer audit with a real or ODA-authored C5 example before implementation. In parallel, inspect the shared getCmColor fallback consumers and identify a bounded preserve-or-refuse strategy without changing normalized behavior speculatively.
